messages:
mia.design: quick design check  thinking through a typed-confirm pattern + CTA wording for big canary jumps, and whether timeline should auto-collapse older versions. sketch: https://figma.redwood/typed-confirm. main asks: confirm modal copy, CTA label, slider snaps, a11y announcements, timeline grouping.
sam_pm: TL;DR  require typed confirmation for any allocation >=50%. also capture a short reason. we had a mistaken 80% change last month.
leo.eng: impl note: slider snap rules: 1% <10%, 5% 10-50%, 10% >50%. typed-confirm will block UI & API unless request contains typed_confirmation token. we can return audit_id in response.
nada_a11y: a11y items: modal H1 must be "Confirm canary allocation"; confirm button should read exactly "Increase to 60%: v2-beta" (include percent + variant). add aria-live polite text: "Allocation set to 60% for v2-beta" after change. contrast: small legend text needs >=4.5:1.
jun.research: usability note: participants wanted an immediate "View audit" link after change. they also preferred expanded timeline by default for investigations; compact toggle for power users. collapsed older history into an "Archived" row was well-received.
mia.design: draft modal copy: "Confirm canary allocation
You are about to route 60% of users to variant 'v2-beta'. This may increase failure exposure. Type 'v2-beta' to confirm.
Checklist: monitoring | rollback plan | on-call notified." thoughts on tone?
sam_pm: prefer "This will send 60% of users to the variant and may increase error rates." less jargon. include the checklist as checkboxes and require selecting at least monitoring. log the free-text reason.
leo.eng: +1 add optional toggle "Enable auto-rollback (5 min)" in modal. backend supports metric-based rollback. API gating: we'll reject non-typed calls above threshold. doc note needed for clients.
nada_a11y: CTA options: "Increase to 60%: v2-beta" beats ambiguous labels. ensure focus order: focus stays on cancel first, then confirm by explicit tab. also expose keyboard shortcut to toggle timeline (press 't').
mia.design: ok final decisions: typed-confirm at >=50%, CTA text format "Increase to {percent}%: {variant}", default expanded timeline up to 8 versions then group older into 'Archived history', provide "View audit" toast link post-change. i'll update figma and the a11y doc.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary update by sam_pm  v2-beta to 60% (auto-rollback=true)  2025-06-07T09:02:00Z
mia.design: thanks all  will run a 15-min review tomorrow 09:30 PT if anyone wants to join.
